description: Saving a cached record should invalidate cached single-record and list-query results for that record, and later reads should be recached.

cases.expected_output:
database=default
invalidation=record_save
single_before=false
list_before=false
single_cached=true
list_cached=true
single_after_save=false
list_after_save=false
single_recached=true
list_recached=true
